params.command:
$paths=@(
'C:\Users\Xxkan\actions-runner-heaven\_work\mhw-mods\mhw-mods',
'C:\Users\Xxkan\actions-runner-heaven-v2\_work\mhw-mods\mhw-mods',
'C:\Users\Xxkan\local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'
)
foreach($p in $paths){
  Write-Output "=== $p ==="
  if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $p '.git'))){Write-Output 'NO_GIT'; continue}
  git -C $p remote -v
  Write-Output ("branch=" + (git -C $p branch --show-current))
  Write-Output ("head=" + (git -C $p rev-parse HEAD))
  Write-Output 'status:'
  git -C $p status --short
  Write-Output ''
}
